title: 城市政策
subtitle: 讨论出行措施与居民影响

questions.prompt: Residents will be consulted before the new parking rules are introduced.
questions.audio: Residents will be consulted before the new parking rules are introduced.
questions.answer: 出台新停车规则前，会征询居民意见。
options: 出台新停车规则前，会征询居民意见。
出台新停车规则后，居民才可以提出意见。
居民已经批准规则，但实施时间还未确定。
新规则只对参加咨询的居民生效。
questions.translation: 出台新停车规则前，会征询居民意见。

questions.prompt: 听公交措施的实施范围。
questions.audio: Private cars will be restricted during rush hour, but buses will still be allowed through.
questions.answer: 高峰时段将限制私家车通行，但公交车仍可通过。
options: 高峰时段将限制私家车通行，但公交车仍可通过。
高峰时段将限制公交车通行，但私家车仍可通过。
全天都禁止私家车和公交车通过。
只有高峰时段才允许私家车进入。
questions.translation: 高峰时段将限制私家车通行，但公交车仍可通过。

questions.prompt: 这笔资金将用于改善人行道。
questions.answer: The funding will be used to improve the pavements.
questions.audio: The funding will be used to improve the pavements.
questions.translation: 这笔资金将用于改善人行道。

questions.prompt: A temporary crossing _____ near the school last month.
questions.instruction: 选择与 last month 一致的被动形式。
questions.audio: A temporary crossing was installed near the school last month.
questions.translation: 上个月学校附近设置了一个临时过街设施。

questions.prompt: 配对城市交通讨论中的词语。
questions.translation: 基础设施、拥堵、意见征询、高峰时段、人行道、无障碍可达性

questions.instruction: 选择这个交通词的意思。

questions.prompt: The scheme was designed to reduce traffic without cutting off access to local shops.
questions.audio: The scheme was designed to reduce traffic without cutting off access to local shops.
questions.instruction: 这项方案同时考虑了什么？
questions.answer: 减少车流，同时保留前往当地商店的通道。
options: 减少车流，同时保留前往当地商店的通道。
关闭当地商店，以便彻底消除车流。
增加车流，同时减少商店营业时间。
只改善购物通道，不考虑交通量。
questions.translation: 该方案旨在减少车流，同时不阻断前往当地商店的通道。

questions.instruction: 注意 intended 和实际担忧的区别。
questions.audio: The proposal is intended to improve access, but some residents are worried about higher rents.
questions.answer: 提案旨在改善出行可达性，但一些居民担心房租上涨。
options: 提案旨在改善出行可达性，但一些居民担心房租上涨。
提案旨在降低房租，但居民担心道路关闭。
提案已经提高房租，居民要求取消全部公交线路。
居民支持涨租，希望以此减少通行人数。
questions.translation: 提案旨在改善出行可达性，但一些居民担心房租上涨。

questions.prompt: The final decision _____ until all comments have been considered.
questions.instruction: 选择表达尚未作出决定的形式。
questions.audio: The final decision won't be made until all comments have been considered.
questions.translation: 所有意见都被考虑后，才会作出最终决定。

dialogue.scene: 居民询问新步行街安排

turns.speaker: alice
turns.text: If this street becomes pedestrian-only, how will deliveries reach the shops?
turns.translation: 如果这条街变成步行街，商店怎么收货？

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: Delivery vehicles would be allowed in before ten each morning.
turns.translation: 送货车辆每天早上十点前可以进入。

turns.speaker: alice
turns.text: The pharmacy also receives urgent deliveries in the afternoon.
turns.translation: 药店下午也会收到急需的货。

tasks.prompt: When would delivery vehicles be allowed in?
